name: Demon Time Exotics brand assets
description: Manifest of every brand asset shipped in @dte/assets. Consumers should reference these paths (via @dte/assets/*) instead of copying files into apps.

usage.githubSocialPreview: Copy branding/social-banner.png to .github/social-image.png (already done at repo root).
usage.ogImage: images/social-preview.png is referenced by apps/landing/index.html og:image.
usage.appIcons: Tauri reads src-tauri/icons/icon.png; Electron uses resources/icon.png; Expo uses app.json icon path.
